privateEvents.absent: all zeros; unrelated transfers and physical card IDs are never encoded

semantics.partition: Exact minimum number of uninterrupted lead plays when the original decision hand has <=12 cards. Above this bound, use a constructive rank-group upper bound; never a prediction of success. One-play cover is always exact.
semantics.nonPlay: Pass and ask leave the hand unchanged. Return hypothetically removes the card but never counts as finishing or overtaking.
semantics.role: Contextual opportunity facts only; no fixed seat role, no heuristic action label and no change to the team reward.
semantics.counts: Use public counts adjusted for transfers in flight. Empty side minimum is zero.
